reason: Both correctly reassured that Eco 40-60 is deliberately long and advised against returning the machine, but Conversation 2 gave a fuller, accurate explanation (energy-label programme, lower actual temperature, mixed 40/60 load), named the model-specific Time Manager and Cottons 40 alternatives the homeowner actually has, and set sensible fault criteria (error codes, overrunning, poor results) that match the expected direction. Conversation 1 was correct but thinner, and its first turn needlessly asked the customer to run a 60°C heater test when nothing suggested a fault, slightly undercutting its own 'not faulty' verdict; it did recover well on the lukewarm door glass question.
